name: @loro/core-rs
description: Rust core — every number that must be identical on iOS, Android, and the server.
//files: Listed file-by-file, not as "pkg": npm's packer will not descend into a directory that has its own package.json, and wasm-pack writes one there. `files: ["pkg"]` therefore ships an empty folder, and the API image boots with no merge engine. Verified with `pnpm --filter @loro/api deploy --prod`.

scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build --target nodejs --out-dir pkg && wasm-pack build --target web --out-dir pkg-web && node scripts/browser-bytes.mjs
scripts.build:bindings: cargo run --bin uniffi-bindgen -- generate --library target/release/libloro_core.dylib --language swift --language kotlin --out-dir bindings
